Multiple women murdered in separate incidents across India

Several women have been murdered in different cities across India in recent incidents. In Bengaluru, a physiotherapist was found dead at a homestay, with police investigating a suspected murder-suicide involving her boyfriend. Another woman was reportedly stabbed to death on a busy Bengaluru road. Separately, a man allegedly traveled from Lucknow to Delhi to kill his wife, with police arresting him. These cases highlight ongoing concerns about violence against women.
